'''Tru Veld''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Teevan/Legends|Teevan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Transit Red, end of the line."<br />"You're a good friend.|Veld gives Skywalker whispered instructions to the illegal [[Great Dordon Caves|Dordon Caves]] podrace during the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of 26 BBY.|<ref name="TDG" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Teevan/Legends|Teevan]], Tru Veld was born to a family on [[Teevan (planet)|Teevan]] who gave him to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. A student of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]], Veld was selected as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ry-Gaul]] at the start of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] which would plague the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for the next decade. During his apprenticeship Veld would construct a crimson-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which he wielded with his left hand. Despite the functionality of the weapon, Veld's lightsaber was poorly designed and had many vital flaws.<ref name="TWOTA" />

Becoming close with fellow apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after meeting in an alley searching for droid parts, the pair joined their masters on several missions together that led them to worlds such as [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]], where they [[Mission to Radnor|assisted]] in the world's evacuation,<ref name="TWOTA" /> and [[Euceron]] where they served as security at the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] with [[Ferus Olin]].<ref name="TDG">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> On a mission with [[Darra Thel-Tanis]], Veld was shocked when she was injured on [[Haariden]]. Assigned to practice his sparring with Master [[Soara Antana/Legends|Soara Antana]] to assist Skywalker hone his battle skills,<ref name="TMOD">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref> Veld became very loyal to Skywalker, standing up for his friend when Olin questioned his loyalties to his master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TMOT">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref> Despite their friendship, Skywalker grew more and more confrontational as time passed, and Veld's failure to understand the antipathy between Skywalker and Olin would only lead to more trouble in the future.<ref name="TFS">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>
[[File:TruVeld2.jpg|thumb|left|Jedi Padawan Tru Veld.]]
Along with their Masters, Veld, Skywalker, Olin and Thel-Tanis were [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|dispatched]] to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to locate and detain the mysterious [[Granta Omega]]. As the Padawans worked together, Veld became truly aware of Skywalker's failings when confronted with Olin and was dismayed by their failure to cooperate. When Veld was injured while fighting [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] and his lightsaber was damaged, Olin noticed that the weapon was on half-power and offered to fix it (although Skywalker, eavesdropping on the interaction, wrongly assumed that Veld had betrayed their friendship and gone to Olin for help instead; as such, Anakin allowed his jealousy to cause him to forget to remind Veld to adjust the [[Flux aperture/Legends|flux aperture]], to ensure Olin's fix held). Ferus did not report the saber damage to the Masters (as was required) and assisted Veld, much to the Teevan's surprise. Veld continued to fight with a flawed weapon, for Olin's repair inadvertently reversed the fixes Skywalker had applied earlier, and the lightsaber's power supply dwindled. Unwittingly, Veld entered the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] alongside the other Jedi with a useless weapon, and when a firefight broke out, his lack of a well-tuned lightsaber proved fatal. After he and Olin had swapped lightsabers at a moment when Veld's weapon began to flicker and fail, Omega unexpectedly came at them from behind, leaving Ferus (who had assumed a backup position) open to attack with the faulty saber. As he attempted to block Omega's blaster bolt from striking him, the weapon would not activate and it shot past Ferus, striking down Padawan Thel-Tanis, who was just then leaping into the fray to protect Olin.<ref name="TFS" />

While the Jedi ultimately completed the mission successfully, Thel-Tanis died from her wounds, filling Veld with grief. Because of his failure to report the malfunctioning weapon, Olin resigned from the Order and departed for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], no longer a Jedi. Veld eventually came to realize that Skywalker had been aware of Olin's faulty fixes to his lightsaber, but he chose to remain silent in order to shame Olin. Confronting Skywalker with his suspicions outside of the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] at the Jedi Temple, Veld ended his friendship with Skywalker that day, a friendship Skywalker knew would never be mended.<ref name="TFS" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Veld was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Having constructed a teal-bladed lightsaber to replace his faulty one, Veld served throughout the war until the very end. When his former Master was dispatched on a top-secret mission to the Outer Rim, Veld was assigned to remain at the Temple to collect and compile very important information which would aid Ry-Gaul in his mission. Veld was in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]] when Anakin Skywalker, now the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, initiated [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] at the Temple. As the Temple burned, Veld was able to flee the slaughter and escape through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].<ref name="LOTJU" /> A special bulletin was issued to [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security personnel]] warning that they should call in assistance from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] before opening fire on the Teevan Knight.<ref name="O66" />

Despite his efforts, Veld was unable to escape the devastation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Veld was ultimately found and executed by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who were once loyal to him and his lightsaber was confiscated. Returning it to the Jedi Temple, the clones added the weapon to a collection of other lightsabers in the [[Storage floor|Temple's storage sub-basement]] as part of a trap to lure other Jedi survivors into the basements to be killed. Having returned to the Temple to investigate the rumored Jedi prison, Ferus Olin discovered Veld's weapon and reflected on his fallen friend, returning the weapon to the pile of lightsabers as a way of honoring his lost friend.<ref name="LOTJU" />

==Personality and traits==
A Teevan with silver eyes, Tru Veld's skin had a silvery cast and his tall, lanky frame was exceptionally flexible and could bend in surprising ways. His long, many-jointed arms and legs caused him to move "like a rolling wave of water."<ref name="TMOT" /> It was this quality that made him an exceptional, versatile fighter.<ref name="TWOTA" />

As a matter of habit, Tru carried small bags of sweet [[figda]] candy in the pocket of his tunic, which he often shared with his friends.<ref name="TWOTA" />

==Powers and abilities==
While moderately skilled in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Veld was less seasoned when it came to a saber's construction, and his [[Red|crimson]]-bladed weapon was produced with several flaws, requiring frequent repairs and maintenance, which he relied on others to perform for him.<ref name="TFS" /> Notwithstanding his weakness in Jedi weapons construction, he possessed a photographic memory and a keen mind that, ironically (in light of his faulty lightsaber), seemed otherwise to grasp with great facility all aspects of technical design and wizardry.<ref name="TWOTA" />
